verdict.rationale: Exa documents a per-key control: you can set a lower usage limit on an individual API key. That gives a key issued to an agent a reduced spend and usage ceiling, a thin form of least privilege. A Team Management API also exists for managing keys, but nothing shows permission scopes or endpoint-level restrictions. Missing for 10: permission or endpoint scopes per key, read-only or product-restricted keys, documented agent-specific credential issuance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Review usage and set a lower limit for an individual key.
Download the OpenAPI specs for the Exa public API and Team Management API in YAML or JSON.
